question: What is the power called when it is devoid of visarga and illuminates all things?
premises: All things are to be illuminated by this power.
When devoid of visarga, that same power is called Shakti-Kundalini.
inference: The visarga-less illuminating power is identified as both Shakti-Kundalini and Prana-Kundalini.
plain_english: When devoid of visarga, that power which illuminates all things is called Shakti-Kundalini, and likewise Prana-Kundalini.
